evals.prompt: I just ran git push on my feature branch. Can you keep an eye on CI and open the PR for review once it's green?
evals.expected_output: Resolves the PR for the current branch read-only, makes one gated offer, watches CI in the background, and on green marks the draft PR ready for review.
assertions: Resolves the PR for the current branch before watching or mutating anything
Makes a single gated offer (via AskUserQuestion) before any side effects
On green CI, marks the draft PR ready for review

evals.prompt: Watch the checks on PR #482 and re-request my reviewers once it passes.
evals.expected_output: Derives the previously-submitted human reviewers (excluding the author and bots), offers, watches CI, and on green re-requests them with gh pr edit --add-reviewer.
assertions: Identifies previously-submitted human reviewers, excluding bots and the PR author
Re-requests reviewers with gh pr edit --add-reviewer on green
Waits for CI to pass before re-requesting

evals.prompt: CI just went red on my branch — what happened?
evals.expected_output: Reports which checks failed, fetches and summarizes the failing logs, gives a short root-cause read, then stops and asks before doing anything.
assertions: Fetches and summarizes the failing check logs (gh run view --log-failed)
Gives a root-cause read and stops to ask before investigating

evals.prompt: I pushed to the default branch just to sync it, follow up on the PR.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the PR first, finds none, and exits silently with no offer and no output.
assertions: Resolves the PR for the branch first and finds none
Exits silently with no offer or output when there is no associated PR

evals.prompt: The watch just exited 0 but I only saw one check run — are we actually green?
evals.expected_output: Explains the watch exit code is unreliable on staged pipelines, re-gathers statusCheckRollup, and re-watches if checks are still pending or the set looks thin.
assertions: Does not trust the watch exit code alone
Re-gathers statusCheckRollup and re-watches if checks are pending or the set is thin
Only treats all-terminal checks as settled

evals.prompt: Once CI is green on my PR, mark it ready and move my linked issue to In Review — and if there's no tracker just skip that part.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the PR and the linked issue read-only, offers the PR advance with a separately-declinable move, and on green marks the draft ready then transitions the linked issue to In Review via the resolved transition; when no tracker or linked issue is present, the move is skipped silently and the PR still advances.
assertions: Resolves the linked issue read-only and matches the transition whose target status is In Review (not by display name)
Offers the issue move as a separately-declinable choice so the PR can still advance while the move is skipped
On green, transitions the linked issue to In Review after the GitHub action, best-effort
When no tracker or linked issue is available, skips the move silently without blocking the PR advance
